digest.component_or_area: core CLI command parsing and registry
propositions: Core commands across _commands/, _engine_support/, and _io/ parse argv imperatively, creating duplicate grammar definitions when argparse factories are added

Runtime handlers in _dispatch_* family must be switched to call per-command parser factories wired via Route.parser_factory, preserving family-specific unknown-token semantics and global flag extraction order
Parser factories must preserve each command family's pre-migration behavior (parse_known_args skip vs reject-exit-2) without normalizing to argparse defaults
All 49 core command handlers must route through S2a parser factories in _parsers/core/ with no parallel imperative grammar remaining, excluding metrics which is already migrated in S2c
